test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven friends - P, Q, R, A, X, Y, and Z - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Y is sitting sixth to the right of Q. P is sitting third to the left of Y. A has Q and X as immediate neighbours. Z is to the immediate right of P.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of R?
solution:
Given:

Seven friends - P, Q, R, A, X, Y, and Z - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

 Y is sitting sixth to the right of Q. P is sitting third to the left of Y.

Z is to the immediate right of P.

A has Q and X as immediate neighbours. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/281787fdb9a0bb60958fa400152f437d4006dd99f7ee0e96f467732774d96194.png] 

Thus, Y sit immediate right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
